title: Unpaid invoices: who to remind this week, and why
description:
A walk through a sample unpaid-invoice report for an invented design firm, for anyone chasing accounts receivable: an aging report, the invoices due a reminder this week, and draft payment reminders.

Unpaid Invoice Tracker with Draft Reminders: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#invoices #smallbusiness

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/unpaid-invoice-tracking?src=youtube&utm_campaign=unpaid-invoice-sample-walkthrough
narration: Which unpaid invoices actually need a reminder this week?
This sample starts with an aging report: what's current, and what's thirty, sixty or ninety days past due.
Then the reminders due this week, and why. One invoice, a hundred and seventeen days overdue, gets a firmer tone, with an offer to talk.
Each reminder is a draft with the exact invoice number and balance, for you to send. No late fees and no legal language.
